description: Injects syafiqkit's output-style ruleset at session start, and loads the syafiqkit menu mod.

hooks.command: if [ -f "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/RULESET.md" ]; then /bin/cat "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/RULESET.md"; else echo 'The syafiqkit files this session loaded from are gone, usually because the plugin was updated while the session was open, so its skills and output-style rules are missing here. Tell the user once: restart this session (or start a new one) to get them back.'; fi
